artworks.title: L'audience (3e planche) (The Hearing) (third plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in a room. A woman in a dark cloak with a formal updo faces a man in a uniform and hat, surrounded by other figures in similar hats. The crowd behind them consists of people in dark suits, with one man leaning against a railing holding a hat. The setting appears to be indoors, with a court-like arrangement of the figures.

artworks.title: Scène de cabinet particulier (planche en largeur au lavis) (Scene in a Private Room) (horizontal plate)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on wove Arches vellum paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals seated at a table. Both are visible from approximately the waist up. The person on the left is leaning forward with their head tilted slightly to the left. The person on the right is seated upright and facing forward, with their hand resting on the table. Facial features are not clearly defined due to the light, monochromatic style of the image. The person on the right appears to have short, dark hair and wears a light-colored top. The clothing details of the person on the left are indistinct. There is a bottle, a plate, and another object on the table. The background is also indistinct and softly rendered in monochromatic tones, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Le bain (planche en hauteur) (The Bath) (vertical plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the back, bending forward near a garment on the floor. The person's head is slightly lowered, with long hair falling down, partially covering their face. The person is bare-chested and wearing dark knee-high socks or stockings. The backdrop includes a bathtub to the left, a shelf with items in the background, and loose lines representing the floor. The setting appears quiet and intimate, depicted in monochrome tones.

artworks.title: En Grèce (In Greece)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in an open landscape. The artwork depicts a scene with fluid, sketchy lines on a light background. On the left, cloaked figures are gathered, while on the right, a solitary figure stands looking towards the horizon. The background shows minimal detailing of a vast landscape with hills or mountains. The composition conveys a peaceful yet somber atmosphere in a pastoral setting.

artworks.title: a) Scène de grève (3e planche) (Scene of a Strike) (third plate) (recto); b) Untitled (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) lithograph on laid paper
b) black lithographic crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd gathered around a man standing on an elevated platform. The scene depicts an event where a large group of people is focused intently on a central figure who appears to be addressing them. The group is huddled together, filling the lower half of the drawing and drawing the viewers' eyes toward the figure standing above them. The man at the center is depicted in a coat, hat, and holding an umbrella. Behind the gathering, an industrial landscape is visible with structures such as factories and smokestacks under a cloudy sky. The drawing uses soft shading and lines to convey both the mass of people and the industrial setting.

artworks.title: Femme assise, la tête dans la main droite (Seated Woman with Her Head Resting on Her Right Hand)
artworks.medium: lithograph in red and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual in a crouching stance, adjusting something on their foot. They have medium-length curly hair covering part of their face and wear a long garment that reaches their feet. The person is seated in a chair with a simple background.

artworks.title: Les instructions pour la journée (The Instructions for the Day)
artworks.medium: color transfer lithograph on laid Arches paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a room. One figure is reclined on a bed, while the other is seated beside the bed. The reclined person's upper body is turned slightly towards the other figure, with their face turned away. The seated person faces forward with a calm expression. They are wearing dark clothing. A high-heeled shoe is on the floor nearby. The background features a green wall with a square lighter area that could be a window or framed piece. The furnishings are outlined with simple lines, maintaining a soft, muted color scheme.

artworks.title: Les instructions pour la journée (The Instructions for the Day)
artworks.medium: color transfer lithograph on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two women in a bedroom-like setting. One woman is sitting up in a bed with her legs extended and covered by a blanket, showing a three-quarters view of her body. Her hair is styled loosely, and she is wearing a long, light-colored garment. The second woman is positioned beside the bed, seated in a chair, and bends forward slightly toward the first woman. Her dark hair is tied up in a bun, and she wears a dark-colored dress. Beside the bed on the floor is a single, light-toned shoe with a heel. The background is painted in muted tones, with indistinct lines suggesting the texture of the walls, and there is a simple, rectangular shape on the wall.

artworks.title: Danseuse accotée contre un portant (avec des figurants) (Dancer Leaning against an Upright (with extras))
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a dancer from the knees up, at the center-right of the drawing. The dancer is shown with her back to the viewer, with her right hand on her hip and her left arm bent upwards, touching the back of her head. She has a bun hairstyle and a slightly turned profile. She wears a tutu with a fitted top and short, wide skirt. The background shows faint outlines of other figures, possibly an audience. The sketch uses lines and shading for depth against a simple backdrop.

artworks.title: Portrait de Renoir (1ère planche) (Portrait of Renoir) (first plate)
artworks.description: This is a sketch drawing illustrating an upper body with a focus on the head and shoulders. The individual is depicted in a three-quarter view, turned slightly to the right. They have a distinct beard and wear a cap. The facial features are minimally detailed, indicating a wise or aged expression. The person's clothing is plain, dark, and lacks additional detail. Cross-hatching is used to create shadows and depth around the person. The background is plain with no discernible features.

artworks.title: Portrait de Renoir (2e planche) (Portrait of Renoir) (second plate)
artworks.description: The image is an artistic sketch depicting the upper half of a man's body. The man is positioned slightly hunched forward and appears to be looking down. His facial features are suggested with minimal pen strokes; he has a prominent nose, a beard, and a cap covering most of his hair. The man's clothing is lightly sketched, indicating a loose jacket or shirt. There are no visible details of jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is a blank, untextured paper, drawing focus entirely to the sketch itself.

artworks.title: Portrait de Renoir (3e planche) (Portrait of Renoir) (third plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a charcoal or pencil sketch of an elderly man from the waist up. He is seated, turned at an angle with his head slightly inclined to the left. The man has a long beard, deep-set eyes, prominent cheekbones, and an angular nose. He wears a hat with a small brim, and simple dark attire. The background is plain with no distinct features, keeping the focus on the subject.

artworks.title: Portrait de Renoir (4e planche) (Portrait of Renoir) (fourth plate)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's upper body. The person is seated at an angle, slightly hunched forward, with one arm bent and placed near their face. The facial features are depicted with sharp lines, showing a prominent nose and downward-looking eyes. The person has a beard and their hair is hidden under a cap. They are wearing a jacket or coat with distinct folds and shadows. The style is sketchy and monochrome, lacking specific details on jewelry or accessories. The background is plain with an off-white textured appearance. In the bottom right corner, the signature and date "Forain" and "Paris 1903" are visible.

artworks.title: Le colporteur juif (The Jewish Peddler)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person standing sideways, walking with arms by face. The person has a beard, a cap, short dark hair peeking from the cap, and a long coat with the collar up. They carry a sack on their back. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Eventail (pour le bal Gavarni) (Fan (for the Gavarni Ball))
artworks.medium: color transfer lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch portraying two main figures, with a focus on their upper bodies. On the left, a woman is depicted from the back, slightly turned towards a man on the right. The woman has an updo hairstyle and is wearing a voluminous dress with puffed sleeves and a bodice. The man facing her has a beard and mustache, wearing a tall hat, suit, and waistcoat. In the background, there is a third, less detailed figure situated between the two main characters.

artworks.title: Lourdes, l'imploration devant la Grotte (4e planche) (Lourdes, Imploring before the Grotto) (fourth plate)
artworks.description: The image is an etched drawing showing two people kneeling on the floor. The man has a beard and facial features with minimal detail. The woman has long hair flowing down her back. The man is holding a boot with his right hand. The background consists of dense crosshatching lines creating a textured effect. The figures are central with no additional objects or details in their immediate environment.

artworks.title: Lourdes, la paralytique (2e planche) (Lourdes, the Paralytic) (second plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white sketch of three figures. Two figures stand close together, one slightly bent forward while the other two lean towards him. The figure on the right, a man with tussled hair and a coat, is supporting the figure on the left, a woman with long hair and a dress. The middle figure is bent over with hands on shoulders and wrapped in fabric. The sketch features faint outlines of more figures in the background, with minimal details. The drawing is done using varying line thicknesses to show form and volume.

artworks.title: Un tableau de papa! (1ère planche) (A Painting of Daddy's!) (first plate)
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph printed chine collé on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals from behind. The taller person on the left is standing slightly hunched forward with short, dark hair. The shorter person on the right is seated, with long wavy hair falling down their back. Both individuals appear to be looking out a window. The taller person is wearing what seems to be a jacket, while the seated individual is dressed in a patterned garment with a long sleeve. No specific details of their clothing, jewelry, or accessories are visible. The background is filled with sketch lines suggesting an outdoor scene.

artworks.title: Scène d'audience (les deux avocats) (Scene of a Hearing (The Two Lawyers))
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with four figures. Three figures are clustered together and a fourth is in the upper right, partially separated. The sketch is abstract and does not provide full details of the bodies. The three central figures are depicted from the shoulders up. Their positioning appears to be in a group, with the tallest figure slightly to the left, looking downward. The facial features are simplistically drawn with minimal lines indicating eyes, noses, and mouths. There is a hint of hair on two figures, primarily as sketched outlines. Clothing is suggested through shaded lines, giving a sense of depth and layering, without detailed patterns or clear representation. The background is filled with scribbled lines encircling the figures, creating texture and a sense of motion or focus around the group. The upper right figure is similarly simplistic, appearing to be partially separated from the central grouping. The overall scene suggests a focus on the interaction or presence of these individuals in an abstract or impressionist style, with no discernible jewelry or objects present.

artworks.title: L'Allemand expulsé (The German Expelled)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures. One figure is placing a hand on the shoulder of the other. The figures are dressed in clothing suggesting a uniform, with one wearing a cap and the other a helmet. The sketch shows an interaction between two individuals. The drawing uses loose, expressive lines to capture movement and interaction.

artworks.title: A la table de jeu (At the Gambling Table)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures around a table. The composition is rendered in black charcoal or pencil strokes. The central figure appears to be leaning over a surface. Behind the central figure are darker, abstract forms suggesting other figures or shadows. The background is filled with hatchings and cross-hatchings contrasting with the lighter foreground.

artworks.title: Le decavé (Cleared Out)
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of two men standing in an indoor setting. The man on the left is dressed formally in a tuxedo with a bow tie and white shirt, while the other man is wearing a large coat over a light-colored shirt with boots. Both men have short, roughly drawn hair and indistinct facial features. The background is crowded with other figures sitting around tables under overhead lighting.

artworks.title: Etude de femme nue, les bras abaissés (Study of a Nude Woman, with Lowered Arms)
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph on laid Arches paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a frontal view of a nude person in a seated position with one knee drawn up. The person is facing forward with the head turned slightly to the side. The facial features are minimal, with only a hint of the profile indicated by soft lines. The hair is styled up in a loose bun. There are no clothing or jewelry on the individual. The lines are simple and expressive, emphasizing the contours of the body. The background is plain with a uniform light tone, highlighting the figure in the foreground.

artworks.title: Etude de femme nue, les mains croisées au-dessous de la tête (Study of a Nude Woman, Her Hands Crossed behind Her Head)
artworks.medium: transfer lithograph on laid Arches paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's upper body seated with one knee bent, viewed from the side. The individual is reclined with both arms raised, hands on the back of their head. The facial features are minimally detailed without eyes or mouth. The hair is shown in a simple style. The person is without clothing or accessories. The background is plain. There are no visible objects or additional elements in the image.
